title: MUSCLE MANGA - Yusuke Urameshi's Physique in YuYu Hakusho
summary: A Muscle Manga character essay on Yusuke Urameshi from YuYu Hakusho. NH frames him as a morally grey anti-hero whose defining trait is following his own path, and whose power grows when pushed past his limits through sheer determination.
claims: Yusuke's mental strength, the willingness to follow his own path regardless of consequences, distinguishes him more than his physical power
Yusuke's grey morality, neither good nor evil, makes him relatable because we are all the product of an internal struggle between good and evil
He is the purest anti-hero: he does things not because he's virtuous but because he wants to
Yusuke's defining trait is powering up in the face of adversity; he gets stronger the more he is pushed to his limits
At only 14 his body is robust and muscular, making him both tireless and dangerous
His training regimen in the manga is one-finger, one-arm handstands for 12 hours on needles, mainly to raise his spirit energy
Unlike a simple deus ex machina, Yusuke's seemingly inexhaustible energy comes from determination, turning his own life force into power to keep fighting
